evals.name: fires-on-raw-material
evals.prompt: Last year I led the migration off our legacy job queue. Took about four months, cut p99 latency roughly 40%, and I had to talk three teams into it without being anyone's manager. Help me write this up for my resume.

evals.name: defers-existing-bullet-to-case-study
evals.prompt: Here's a bullet from my resume: 'Reduced p99 latency 40% by migrating off a legacy job queue.' I want to build that out into a full write-up for my portfolio site.

assertions.text: Routes to portfolio-case-study-writer, which expands an existing bullet
